senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) flux, gonorrhea, prolonged menstruation.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 35b:9">Nidd. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ דומה</he> the flux (of the gonorrhea) resembles &c.
